qualification.education_qualification: Degree in Engineering or Technology in Electronics and Communication, Information Technology, Computer Science or Fashion Designing, plus ten years' training-related experience including at least two years' administrative experience; analogous post or five years' regular service at Level-12
qualification.details: Qualification: Officers under the Central Government or State Governments or Union Territory Administration or PSUs or Recognized research institution or University or statutory or autonomous organization; (A)(i) Holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) With five years regular service in the post Level-12 in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; (B)(i) A degree in Engineering or Technology in Electronics and Communication or Information Technology or Computer Science or Fashion Designing from a recognized University or Institute Experience: Ten years experience relating to planning or organizing or implementation of training in Technical or Vocational Training Institute or Organization after acquiring the qualification at (B)(i), including at least two years administrative experience Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the last date of receipt of applications) | Other conditions: | Open to officers of Central or State Governments, UT Administration, PSUs, recognized research institutions, universities, statutory or autonomous organizations Officer must be holding an analogous post on regular basis, or have five years' regular service at Level-12 or equivalent | Desirable: | Master of Business Administration from a recognized University or Institute

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Matrix Level-13; pay and terms regulated by DOPT's OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt (Pay-1) dated 17.06.2010

how_to_apply: Fill the Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma at Annexure-II and sign it.
Get it countersigned with seal by the Cadre/Appointing authority.
Attach the seven enclosures listed in the notice (APARs, Integrity Certificate, Vigilance Clearance, penalty certificate, verification certificate, Cadre Clearance).
Cadre Authorities/Heads of Departments forward the application to the Deputy Secretary (Establishment.), DGT, Room No. 220, Kaushal Bhawan, New Moti Bagh, New Delhi-110023.
Application must reach within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News.
Make sure it reaches by 19 January 2027.
important_instructions: Pay Band and Grade Pay under ACP/MACP should not be shown as the pay of the post held on regular basis Applicants from organisations not following Government pay scales may enclose the latest salary slip Employer certifies that the officer will be relieved immediately if selected

content_sections.heading: DGT Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. A-35021/1/2026-O/oDEPT. SECY (ESTT. I) gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DGT notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers under the Central Government or State Governments or Union Territory Administration or PSUs or Recognized research institution or University or statutory or autonomous organization; (A)(i) Holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) With five years regular service in the post Level-12 in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; (B)(i) A degree in Engineering or Technology in Electronics and Communication or Information Technology or Computer Science or Fashion Designing from a recognized University or Institute Experience: Ten years experience relating to planning or organizing or implementation of training in Technical or Vocational Training Institute or Organization after acquiring the qualification at (B)(i), including at least two years administrative experience Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the last date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Open to officers of Central or State Governments, UT Administration, PSUs, recognized research institutions, universities, statutory or autonomous organizations Officer must be holding an analogous post on regular basis, or have five years' regular service at Level-12 or equivalent Desirable: Master of Business Administration from a recognized University or Institute

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay and other terms and conditions of deputation regulated in accordance with DOPT's OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt (Pay-1) dated 17.06.2010 as amended from time to time. Method of recruitment: deputation (including short term contract) Tenure initially for one year, extendable for three years Deputation period, including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed five years

rows.event: Date of notice (signed by Under Secretary)

content_sections.heading: How Will DGT Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Assessment of the Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents by the Selection Committee The CV and supporting documents on Essential Qualification/Work Experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in Annexure-II, signed by the candidate and countersigned with seal by the Cadre/Appointing authority Attested copies of APARs for the last 5 years, attested on each page by an officer of Under Secretary rank or above Integrity Certificate and Vigilance Clearance No major or minor penalty certificate for the last 10 years of service Certificate that the particulars have been verified and found correct as per service records Cadre Clearance Certificate

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Pay Band and Grade Pay under ACP/MACP should not be shown as the pay of the post held on regular basis Applicants from organisations not following Government pay scales may enclose the latest salary slip Employer certifies that the officer will be relieved immediately if selected

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DGT Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 19 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DGT Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Director of Training (Women Training).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DGT Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II (Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma) of this notice) and send it to Deputy Secretary (Establishment.), Directorate General of Training, Room No. 220, Second Floor, Kaushal Bhawan, New Moti Bagh, New Delhi-110023, by by post through proper channel, to reach by 19 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the last date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Matrix Level-13; pay and terms regulated by DOPT's OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt (Pay-1) dated 17.06.2010.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree in Engineering or Technology in Electronics and Communication, Information Technology, Computer Science or Fashion Designing, plus ten years' training-related experience including at least two years' administrative experience; analogous post or five years' regular service at Level-12.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to officers of Central or State Governments, UT Administration, PSUs, recognized research institutions, universities, statutory or autonomous organizations. Officer must be holding an analogous post on regular basis, or have five years' regular service at Level-12 or equivalent.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assessment of the Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents by the Selection Committee. The CV and supporting documents on Essential Qualification/Work Experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Method of recruitment: deputation (including short term contract). Tenure initially for one year, extendable for three years. Deputation period, including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed five years.
